detail.longDescription: DevOps'ish 322: Linux wireless shuts the door on AI slop patches, KYAML fixes the Norway Bug, and more The Linux wireless maintainer stops arguing with LLMs, KYAML gets kubectl to quit lying about Norway, Charity Majors says the skepticism window has closed, and five AI rivals agree on a plugin format that punts on permissions. https:// devopsish.com/322/ # DevOps # Kubernetes # SRE # AI
